WITH seeds AS (SELECT * FROM unnest(%s::text[],%s::bigint[],%s::double precision[]) AS s(id,revision,score)), matched AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.id,e.revision,max(s.score) AS score FROM memory_episode_members seed JOIN seeds s ON seed.memory_id=s.id AND seed.memory_revision=s.revision JOIN memory_episodes e ON e.tenant_id=seed.tenant_id AND e.owner_id=seed.owner_id AND e.brain_id=seed.brain_id AND e.id=seed.episode_id AND e.revision=seed.episode_revision
